valuation.method: Tangible Book Value per share (TBVPS) x justified P/TBV at the 12-month target date, anchored to Q3 2026 TBVPS of $31.90, 14.6% adjusted ROTCE, and management's 15% 2027 ROTCE target.

bear.driver: NIM compression or higher credit losses keep ROTCE near 11-12% and slow TBV accretion

base.driver: Balance-sheet repositioning and LightStream sale support 15% ROTCE in 2027 with steady capital return
base.assumption: Forward TBVPS $34.50 at 1.55x P/TBV (~10.9x FY2027E EPS of $4.92)

bull.driver: Stronger fee income, buybacks, and faster path toward 16%+ ROTCE

valuation.implied_by_close: At the $49.97 close, the market prices TFC at 1.57x Q3 2026 TBVPS ($31.90) and 1.45x base forward TBVPS ($34.50); the named-analyst sample ($50.00-$56.00) implies 1.45x-1.62x base forward TBVPS.
valuation.sensitivity: Each 0.10x change in P/TBV on $34.50 forward TBVPS moves the base target by $3.45 (6.9 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: Adjusted ROTCE progression toward 15% and net interest margin (NIM) following the AFS securities repositioning and LightStream sale
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 2026 earnings release and early-2027 strategic and financial outlook

analyst_notes: Following Q3 2026 earnings on October 16, 2026 (adjusted EPS $1.16 vs. $0.56 GAAP due to the $1.45B AFS securities repositioning loss), several covering analysts trimmed targets into the $50-$55 range (UBS and Citigroup to $50, RBC to $51), while Evercore ISI edged up to $55 and J.P. Morgan to $51.50. The named-analyst targets cluster tightly around our $53.48 base case (+7.0% upside). Note: Baird's David George upgraded TFC to Outperform on November 23, 2026, which is after the November 13, 2026 reference close and excluded from the snapshot.
